description: Status, progress, and cost of one Company Search or Company Enrich task, plus a page of the companies delivered so far: domain, name, url, location, fit score (null for Company Enrich) and why it matched, primary_email and primary_contact, public emails, phones, and social profiles with the page each came from (source_url), leaders with their roles, title, LinkedIn profile, and emails (each with its verification status; inferred ones with source: inferred and a confidence), contact_coverage, and enrichment (status partial or complete, and each stage: profile, contacts, people, email_patterns, email_check). Free: it reads a task you already started and runs no new search. Cost fields are reserved_cost_usd and, once the task ended, final_cost_usd. The data came from each company's own website, public web search, and public LinkedIn profiles. Companies arrive while the task runs and are filled in place by the later stages: pass the returned next_cursor as cursor to get only the companies delivered since then, and call without cursor to read every company in its latest version. stage enriching means every company is delivered and only later stages of some are left. When done is true and has_more is false you have every company. An ended task has completion_reason (why it stopped; all_domains_processed for Company Enrich), coverage_limited: true when a budget stopped it before count (more companies may match), and warnings. Company Search results have fully_verified (every criterion confirmed by the company's own pages) and unverified_criteria (criteria that are unknown or not met, or a disqualifier that applies). These are information only: the company still qualified.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous company-search-status call, to get only the companies delivered since then. Omit to read from the first company, each in its latest version.

include_companies.description: Set false to read only the status, progress, and cost.

task_id.description: task_id returned by company-search or company-enrich, example: '5b33f3ee-168b-4780-9c8e-63a626781872'. A People Search task_id is not found here.

name: company-search-status
title: Get Company Search Status
